page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a running head at the top. Headings centred; a poem set in italic lines below. Left edge carries clipped line-starts (no marginal notes visible). Page number at top right.

main_text.head: D. O. M. S.
main_text.p: ANNAM TARVFFAM, NOBILI FRANCO TARVFO CIVE GENVENSI NATAM, ANNO VITÆ HONESTIS- PERACTÆ XXV. RELIGIOSISS. IN CHRISTO MORTVAM,
THEODORVS BEZA VITRICVS, CATHARINA PLANA MATER, BAPTISTA ROCHVS MARITVS,
MOESTISS. HOC FVNESTO CARMI-NE LVGEBANT, GENEVÆ, MAR-TII XXIX. ANNO VLTIMI TEM-PORIS CIↃ IↃ XCVIII.
ANNA, eheu priuigna tuo suauissima Bizæ, Et plus quam ꝯlla ꝯlli filia grata patri,

p.i: ANNA, tua nuper tam filia chara parenti, Quam matri ꝯlla ꝯlli filia chara sua,
ANNA, tuo coniux tam nuper amata marito, Fratri accepta ꝯlli quam fuit ꝯlla soror,
Iacces, nobis properata morte, relinquens Pignora felicis bis duo coniugij:
ANNA, tuos quisquis mores cognouit, amauit

page.notes: Several words in the verse are set in italic with heavy ligatures and the first line's opening word is partly damaged; "ANNA" at the start of the verse lines and "Iacces" are read with [?] risk. Left-edge line-starts of the first heading are damaged by the scan edge. Text cut off at the bottom of the page; the final line may continue on the next page.
